summary: BioLineRx Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement of ADSs and warrants. The company agreed to sell 480,696 ADSs and pre-funded warrants for 868,225 ADSs at $2.78 per ADS, plus unregistered warrants for 2,023,382 ADSs at $2.78 exercise price. Gross proceeds expected ~$3.75M, with Chardan Capital Markets as placement agent (7% fee). Offering closed on August 31, 2026. Net proceeds for R&D and working capital. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
